import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import App from '@src/response-apps/shop/playerShop/description/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { withBackendRepeatDetection } from '@src/utils/backendRepeatDetector';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

/**
 * 店铺简介指令
 * - 指令格式：/店铺简介 新简介
 */
export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const text = (e.MessageText ?? '').trim();
  const m = text.match(/店铺简介\s+(.+)/);

  if (!m?.[1]?.trim()) {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('请输入店铺简介：/店铺简介 内容');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText('简介最长100字'));

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '店铺简介',
        content: md,
        footer: [{ label: '我的小店', command: '/我的小店' }]
      })
    );

    return;
  }

  const desc = m[1].trim();

  try {
    const result = await App({ messageText: e.MessageText, bid, uid, description: desc, request: createBackendRequestContext(e) });

    if (result.code === 'LOAD_FAILED') {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText(result.data.message);

      void message.send(
        FormatGui({
          isPrivate,
          bid,
          title: '店铺简介',
          content: md,
          footer: [{ label: '我的小店', command: '/我的小店' }]
        })
      );

      return;
    }

    const md = Format.createMarkdown();
    const displayMsg = await withBackendRepeatDetection(bid, uid, e.MessageText, result.data.message, createBackendRequestContext(e));

    md.addText(displayMsg);

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '店铺简介',
        content: md,
        footer: [{ label: '我的小店', command: '/我的小店' }]
      })
    );
  } catch {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('更新简介失败，请稍后再试');

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '店铺简介',
        content: md,
        footer: [{ label: '我的小店', command: '/我的小店' }]
      })
    );
  }
});
